remarks: Remarkably Charming Condo in Amenity-Rich Building! Conveniently situated in the pet friendly high-rise building of Hayes House Condominiums, this 1BR/1BA residence truly captures the essence of urban living. Bursting with distinct advantages, this beautifully maintained property includes access to exclusive amenities, such as a fitness center, courtyard with grills, private storage locker, community room, 24-hour security, on-site superintendent, concierge, and bike storage. Impeccably neat and tidy, the condo features an entry closet, a secondary walk-in closet, an open floorplan, attractive neutral paint hues, tons of dazzling natural lighting, oversized windows, and a spacious living room with direct balcony access. Easily create delicious meals in the fully-equipped kitchen, which has updated appliances, ample countertops, white cabinetry and an adjoining dining area. Ideally sized for versatile furniture arrangement, the bedroom boasts lovely sunset views, a walk-in closet, a linen closet, and a full bathroom with a shower/tub combo and a storage vanity. Additional features include secure garage parking with available guest parking, community laundry, HOA includes heat, cooling, and hot water. Near Metro North to NYC, I-95, parks, shops, beach, restaurants, entertainment, medical facilities, LA Fitness, and public transit, and more! Relocate just steps from Downtown Stamford, and start experiencing the fabulous life you deserve!
